p: The High Street is the main shopping spine of Ayr, so MERKUR at number 244 is right in the middle of things. It's an 18+ adult venue. Once you've had a go, the town has a lot more to offer than shops.

Ayr's sandy beach and esplanade are a short walk away, great for a breezy stroll with views across the Firth of Clyde towards Arran on a clear day. Burns fans should head to Alloway on the southern edge of town, where the Robert Burns Birthplace Museum, Burns Cottage and the Brig o' Doon are all close together. Ayr Racecourse hosts some big meetings if you fancy a day at the races.
